phase_namespace_note: phase is the ADW-phase namespace (plan | build | test | review | document | repair, or the phase names this workflow declares). It is NOT the task-state namespace: GATE_RESULT.json records that under task_state for exactly this reason. Two records a controller reads back to back must not disagree about a shared key.
attempt_kind_note: attempt is this phase's attempt index; attempt_kind names which counter in TASK_STATE.attempts this attempt increments (invocation_retry | output_correction | gate_repair | test_fix | review_revision | restart). Counting a phase re-run without naming its kind is what makes 'attempt 4 of 2' possible. Caps bind the run, not the session: a new session or subagent does not reset them.
execution_status_vocabulary: completed | failed | blocked | cancelled. This is the phase's execution, not a check result and not a task state. An agent completion is not a passing check, human acceptance, or shipping permission.
summary: Template only; required inputs and artifacts are not yet supplied.
evidence_source_note: source records provenance: executed (ran it) | inspected (read the code or diff) | documented (a doc or README says so) | asserted (an agent said so). hierarchy_rank is the evidence-hierarchy tier of the claim (1 enforced gate with retained output, 2 independently reproduced command, 3 inspected code/diff tied to a criterion, 4 prior artifact or commit, 5 documentation claim, 6 agent assertion). Provenance is a different axis from confidence: unverified says how sure you are, source says where the claim came from. Never promote a weaker claim into a stronger one by restating it.
